collector.registration: engine/src/state-sources.mjs registers the current official ABCA barrel-selection page, while the collector adds the reviewed active-license directory as searchable, directory-only premises.

storeIdentity.proof: Each searchable premise is bound to an active ABCA retail-liquor license number, business name, official address text, and city. Directory identity never becomes inventory identity.

sourceSemantics.availability: The official barrel-selection page proves only that West Virginia retailers may be able to order a current listed selection. It does not confirm any store has shelf stock, pickup, delivery, or quantity.

stateFilter.assertion: Lifecycle-backed state controls expose West Virginia only after promotion evidence activates the state.

areaFilter.reason: The official update is statewide and does not claim county, city, or store inventory.

preferences.assertion: Lifecycle-backed preference normalization retains the West Virginia state selection after promotion.

dashboard.assertion: The dashboard uses the same lifecycle-backed state option and non-inventory coverage summary.

dropFeedApi.assertion: The customer feed accepts the exact WV state filter and exposes only current official selection rows with an explicit not-live-shelf-inventory caveat.

finder.assertion: The location export includes all 180 reviewed active ABCA license premises as searchable directory-only identities.

alerts.assertion: Lifecycle, canonicalization, export, and customer visibility keep every WV row false for inventory, watch, email, SMS, and delivery eligibility.

monitoring.assertion: The source report records useful current rows only when the current-year official section parses; missing or stale headings fail closed.

export.assertion: Export preserves six source-stock identities as on-site-only official updates and 180 directory premises without creating exact-store inventory or alerts.

shadow.reason: Three GitHub Actions shadow runs returned 186 signals, 180 directory-only exact premises, zero alert candidates, and no roadblocks.

canary.reason: Two isolated GitHub Actions canary runs exported six non-alertable official-selection cards while production publication and alert delivery stayed disabled.

production.assertion: This manifest does not claim production deployment.
production.reason: Production activation requires immutable promotion provenance, guarded merge, targeted refresh, and canonical verification.
